headline: ¿Cuáles fueron las reuniones bilaterales de Sheinbaum durante la APEC 2026?
summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum held bilateral meetings at APEC 2026 covering trade, investment, energy, technology and diplomatic cooperation. The article did not name the counterparts.
why: Mexico's trade and investment relationships affect manufacturing, exports and foreign direct investment. APEC is a forum for Pacific Rim economic cooperation.
